questions.question: D1 — Review focus. Project/branch/task: User Dashboard plan on main. ELI10: I rated this plan 4/10 on design completeness. Biggest gaps: no visual hierarchy (which panel wins on first view), panel states named but never designed (empty copy, skeleton shape, error/retry layout), and no responsive layout per breakpoint. Mockups come next, then all 7 review dimensions unless you want a narrower focus. Stakes if we pick wrong: a narrow focus leaves accessibility or state gaps for the implementer to guess. Recommendation: A because the plan is early and every dimension has open gaps. Completeness: A=10/10, B=6/10. Pros / cons: A) All 7 passes (recommended) ✅ Covers hierarchy, states, journey, slop risk, specificity, responsive and accessibility in one sitting ✅ Each gap still gets its own decision, so you can skip any fix ❌ More questions to answer, roughly one per real gap found. B) Focus on states + hierarchy only ✅ Faster; targets the two gaps most likely to ship looking broken ✅ Fewer decisions to make today ❌ Responsive, modal/toast accessibility and copy stay unspecified for implementer. Net: thoroughness now versus fewer questions today.

options.label: All 7 passes (recommended)
options.description: ✅ Full coverage of every design dimension, one decision per gap. ✅ Nothing left for the implementer to guess. ❌ More questions overall.

options.label: States + hierarchy only
options.description: ✅ Faster, targets the riskiest gaps. ✅ Fewer decisions. ❌ Responsive, a11y and copy stay unspecified.
